Hi team,

Thanks for a productive sync this morning. I wanted to capture the follow-ups and exec asks so we have a single source for QBR prep. Please review the items below and confirm owners/timelines by EOD. I attached the latest slide deck and an empty tracker template.

High-priority exec asks:
- BrightHealth wants a clear migration path from the hosted model to Dedicated for predictable throughput. Request: one-pager showing options, cost delta, and time-to-migrate. Owner: Dev. Due: Thu 7/22 COB.
- Exec wants a safety/rollback plan for the planned quantized model rollouts — include failover model variants and SLA impact. Owner: Markus. Due: Fri 7/24 12:00pm PT.

Product/roadmap questions to address in QBR:
- Can we commit to a supported sequence-length SLAs for the new long-context model? Action: Evelyn to confirm perf envelope and any hard limits. Due: Thu 7/22 3pm PT.
- Need recommendation on batching/cost knobs for the BrightHealth clinical inference workload (high concurrency, short responses). Dev to propose config + estimated cost savings. Due: Fri 7/24.

Operational asks:
- Enable request-level tracing for the BrightHealth test tenant for one week starting 7/25. Owner: Tessa (ops) to coordinate with infra.
- Attachments and evidence for SOC-2 controls requested by BrightHealth procurement — they asked for sample audit logs and data retention policy. Markus to pull the logs. Due: Tue 7/27.

Please reply inline if anything needs reassigning. I will consolidate into the tracker and share with Sara/Tom by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks,

Laura — I dug into the perf envelopes for the long-context model. Short summary:

- We can support up to 8k tokens at ~1.2x baseline latency on p4d, but throughput drops non-linearly after 4k for batched workloads.
- Hard limits depend on KV cache memory; for quantized variants the practical tested limit is 10k but with higher variance.

Action: I'll update the slide deck with a perf slide showing 1) latency-by-length curves 2) trade-offs for batching at >4k tokens. Due Thu 7/22 3pm PT.

Note: For BrightHealth's clinical inference (mostly <1k tokens), the above constraints are less critical — focus on batching and trace instrumentation.

Evelyn
